<?php

class RateLimiter {
    private $redis;
    private $maxRequests;
    private $windowSeconds;

    public function __construct($redis, $maxRequests = 100, $windowSeconds = 60) {
        $this->redis = $redis;
        $this->maxRequests = $maxRequests;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
    }

    public function isAllowed(string $clientId): bool {
        $key = "rate_limit:{$clientId}";
        $current = (int)$this->redis->get($key);
        if ($current >= $this->maxRequests) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->redis->multi();
        $this->redis->incr($key);
        $this->redis->expire($key, $this->windowSeconds);
        $this->redis->exec();
        return true;
    }
}

class RetryPolicy {
    private $maxRetries;
    private $backoffMs;

    public function __construct(int $maxRetries = 3, int $backoffMs = 500) {
        $this->maxRetries = $maxRetries;
        $this->backoffMs = $backoffMs;
    }

    public function execute(callable $operation) {
        $attempt = 0;
        $lastException = null;
        while ($attempt < $this->maxRetries) {
            try {
                return $operation();
            } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
                $lastException = $e;
                $attempt++;
                usleep($this->backoffMs * 1000 * $attempt);
            }
        }
        throw $lastException;
    }
}

class FileMetadata {
    public $filename;
    public $size;
    public $checksum;
    public $processingHints;

    public function __construct(string $filename, int $size, string $checksum, array $hints = []) {
        $this->filename = $filename;
        $this->size = $size;
        $this->checksum = $checksum;
        $this->processingHints = $hints;
    }
}

class ProcessingContext {
    private $metadata;
    private $state;

    public function __construct(FileMetadata $metadata) {
        $this->metadata = $metadata;
        $this->state = [];
    }

    public function getMetadata(): FileMetadata {
        return $this->metadata;
    }

    public function setState(string $key, $value): void {
        $this->state[$key] = $value;
    }

    public function getState(string $key, $default = null) {
        return $this->state[$key] ?? $default;
    }
}

class FileProcessingService {
    private $rateLimiter;
    private $retryPolicy;
    private $uploadDir;
    private $cacheDir;

    public function __construct(RateLimiter $rateLimiter, RetryPolicy $retryPolicy, string $uploadDir, string $cacheDir) {
        $this->rateLimiter = $rateLimiter;
        $this->retryPolicy = $retryPolicy;
        $this->uploadDir = $uploadDir;
        $this->cacheDir = $cacheDir;
    }

    public function processUpload(string $clientId, string $filePath, array $options = []): array {
        if (!$this->rateLimiter->isAllowed($clientId)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Rate limit exceeded');
        }

        $realPath = realpath($filePath);
        if ($realPath === false || strpos($realPath, realpath($this->uploadDir)) !== 0) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid file path');
        }

        $content = file_get_contents($realPath);
        if ($content === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Failed to read file');
        }

        $checksum = hash('sha256', $content);
        $metadata = new FileMetadata(basename($realPath), strlen($content), $checksum);
        $context = new ProcessingContext($metadata);

        $cachedResult = $this->loadFromCache($checksum, $options);
        if ($cachedResult !== null) {
            return $cachedResult;
        }

        $result = $this->retryPolicy->execute(function() use ($context, $content, $options) {
            return $this->executeProcessing($context, $content, $options);
        });

        $this->saveToCache($checksum, $options, $result);
        return $result;
    }

    private function loadFromCache(string $checksum, array $options): ?array {
        $cacheKey = $this->buildCacheKey($checksum, $options);
        $cachePath = $this->cacheDir . '/' . $cacheKey . '.cache';

        if (!file_exists($cachePath)) {
            return null;
        }

        $cacheAge = time() - filemtime($cachePath);
        if ($cacheAge > 3600) {
            unlink($cachePath);
            return null;
        }

        $raw = file_get_contents($cachePath);
        if ($raw === false) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->deserializeCacheEntry($raw);
    }

    private function saveToCache(string $checksum, array $options, array $result): void {
        $cacheKey = $this->buildCacheKey($checksum, $options);
        $cachePath = $this->cacheDir . '/' . $cacheKey . '.cache';

        $serialized = serialize($result);
        file_put_contents($cachePath, $serialized);
    }

    private function buildCacheKey(string $checksum, array $options): string {
        $normalized = $options;
        ksort($normalized);
        return hash('sha256', $checksum . json_encode($normalized));
    }

    private function deserializeCacheEntry(string $raw): ?array {
        $result = unserialize($raw);
        if (!is_array($result)) {
            return null;
        }
        return $result;
    }

    private function executeProcessing(ProcessingContext $context, string $content, array $options): array {
        $format = $options['format'] ?? $this->detectFormat($content);
        $context->setState('format', $format);

        switch ($format) {
            case 'json':
                $parsed = json_decode($content, true);
                if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid JSON content');
                }
                break;
            case 'csv':
                $parsed = str_getcsv($content);
                break;
            case 'xml':
                libxml_disable_entity_loader(true);
                $parsed = simplexml_load_string($content, 'SimpleXMLElement', LIBXML_NOENT | LIBXML_NONET);
                if ($parsed === false) {
                    throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid XML content');
                }
                $parsed = json_decode(json_encode($parsed), true);
                break;
            default:
                $parsed = ['raw' => base64_encode($content)];
        }

        return [
            'filename' => $context->getMetadata()->filename,
            'size' => $context->getMetadata()->size,
            'checksum' => $context->getMetadata()->checksum,
            'format' => $format,
            'data' => $parsed,
            'processed_at' => time()
        ];
    }

    private function detectFormat(string $content): string {
        $trimmed = ltrim($content);
        if (isset($trimmed[0])) {
            if ($trimmed[0] === '{' || $trimmed[0] === '[') return 'json';
            if ($trimmed[0] === '<') return 'xml';
        }
        return 'csv';
    }
}
